rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for what is left after some has been used or removed.

example.english: We ate half of this box of cookies, so give the remainder to my little brother.
example.traditional: 呢盒餅食咗一半，剩返嗰啲留畀細佬啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 hap6 beng2 sik6 zo2 jat1 bun3 sing6 faan1 go2 di1 lau4 bei2 sai3 lou2 laa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the amount left over in a division calculation.

example.english: When seven is divided by two, the remainder is one.
example.jyutping: cat1 ceoi4 ji6 jyu4 sou3 hai6 jat1
